title: Dynamic rephasing in a telecom warm vapor quantum memory
summary: The Off-Resonant Cascaded Absorption (ORCA) protocol in warm atomic vapors offers a scalable platform for high-bandwidth, low noise quantum memories, but its coherence time is fundamentally limited by Doppler-induced dephasing. We introduce and experimentally demonstrate a dynamic rephasing protocol that counteracts Doppler dephasing in a telecom-band ORCA quantum memory.
